resources.string: Server unavailable. Check address and server version.
Add photos to an album to upload them. Refresh checks the server; it does not retry failed uploads.
Create your first album and add your favourite photos.
New albums are private by default. Sign in with Google to share selected albums with family.
A private key is created automatically on this phone. Knowing its ID is not enough to access your photos.
Uninstalling, clearing app data or resetting the phone loses access. Server files remain, but recovery is not available in this version.
HTTPS for public servers; HTTP only on a trusted local network. Use an origin without a path. Changing the address opens a separate space.
Applies only after a successful upload. Compression creates an extra copy inside the app; it does not shrink the gallery original.
This requests deletion of the selected original after upload. Android may deny deletion. Keep another backup; server storage alone is not a backup strategy.
A personal photo album by Bacus Lab.
Family sharing is available for Google-linked family members.
Optional. Sign in to restore access and combine the archive of phones using the same Google account.
Google sign-in failed. Check the server, Google test-user access and try again.
Choose photos from your phone. They will be uploaded to your server.
Preview only. Download the original to view it on this device.
This removes the local list entry and thumbnail, not the gallery original or server file. Server photos can reappear after refresh.
Choose exactly who can see this album. Family membership alone never exposes a private album.
No other family members yet. Create an invitation in Family settings first.
